description: Véloroute et itinéraires cyclables jalonnés en Ouest Cornouaille is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Michael Häusle. This dataset contains information on cycle routes marked by directional signs in use (Véloroute V5 La Littorale, burg-beach routes, inter-municipal routes). It covers West Cornwall i.e. the perimeter of the communities of communes Douarnenez Communauté, Cap Sizun - Pointe du Raz, Haut Pays Bigouden, Pays Bigouden Sud. Coverage: Michael Häusle. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle route and cycle routes marked out in West Cornwall" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Michael Häusle. Its keywords include Haut Pays Bigouden, Pays Bigouden Sud, Douarnenez Communauté, Cap Sizun - Pointe du Raz, itinéraires jalonnés, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2020-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
